parts.name: mattress_nem_cao_su_160
sources: A mattress of 160 by 200 by 10 cm: its cover sewn from 4 pieces (World.Sewing.Cushion).
Mattresses of 120 and 160 by 200 cm, 5, 10 and 15 cm thick (Vạn Thành; Dunlopillo: 160 by 200 by 10 cm).
A cover of knitted ticking of polyester, 200 g/m2 (MH Chine: jacquard knitted mattress fabric; knitted tickings are 150 to 650 g/m2).
Natural latex, 75 kg/m3 (Heveya: 65 to 85 kg/m3 by ISO 845; Vạn Thành makes it 5, 10 and 15 cm thick).
